command: set -euo pipefail; adb start-server >/dev/null; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) exit 20;; esac; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 2; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 3; if ! adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; then adb shell input tap 503 159; sleep 6; fi; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; echo PRECONDITION_PASS PID=$PID
